name: Black Forest
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) is best for hiking and lake swimming at Titisee; the thermal baths at Baden-Baden and the forest's Christmas-market towns make it genuinely worth visiting in winter too.
overview: Dense forest, the birthplace of the cuckoo clock and Black Forest cake, and Baden-Baden's historic thermal spas — a quieter, greener corner of southern Germany.
costOverview: Forest towns and hiking huts stay affordable — Baden-Baden's historic thermal spas and the region's surprising cluster of Michelin-starred restaurants are the real splurges.
